name: High-Sensitivity Sound Sensor
description: Like an ear! Detects acoustic pressure waves with an electret condenser microphone and LM358 amplifier.
realWorldAnalogy: Like an ear! Detects acoustic pressure waves with an electret condenser microphone and LM358 amplifier.
datasheetRef: Arduino KY-037 Sensitive microphone sensor module.pdf
wiringGuidance: Connect VCC (Red wire) to 5V, GND (Dark Slate wire) to GND. Connect A0 (Yellow wire) to analog pin A0 and D0 (Green wire) to digital pin 2.
commonMistakes: Leaving the onboard blue potentiometer unadjusted—turn it until the onboard LED just turns off in quiet room noise.
Using digital pin D0 instead of analog pin A0 when trying to measure gradual acoustic volume.

miniExperiment.title: Clap & Noise Visualizer
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, A0 to Analog Pin A0.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: A steady stream of values around 500-600. Clapping near the mic causes sharp spikes above 750.
